name: NG-5
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle prepares a distraction with NG-5. The volatile chemical, Nitromirglyceronium, is the ignition compound he needs for wagons loaded with dynamite.

sections.title: A Volatile Reagent
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome operative in the Stonetalon Mountains, and NG-5 is the compound he needs for his engineering plans. Its full name is Nitromirglyceronium. The hazardous solution provides the reaction to detonate wagons loaded with dynamite, making a great explosion to distract his adversaries in the region.

faq.answer: NG-5 is short for Nitromirglyceronium, a highly unstable chemical used to ignite explosives in gnomish engineering.
Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer in the Stonetalon Mountains, needs NG-5 to ignite several wagons packed with dynamite. He plans to use the explosions as a distraction.
NG-5 is extremely dangerous to handle. Its supplier warns couriers to treat it with absolute care, and jokes that anyone who is not Gaxim's ally will likely blow themselves to pieces.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may know NG-5 as Nitromirglyceronium, a temperamental chemical catalyst tinkers prize when ordinary black powder lacks the force for heavy ordinance.
As a gnome, you may recognize the high-risk ingenuity in using an unstable chemical to blow up whole wagons of dynamite as a simple distraction.
